rules: question_selection.rs select: sorted unique IDs; positive easy band yields uniform hash draw within easy; zero easy weight excludes it, no policy selects smallest ID. learning.rs validate_practice_question rejects retired, incomplete, multistep; unavailable_questions excludes seen/reserved/fixed future lesson items.
eligibility: All five single-radio complete, unretired easy records remain usable before learner exclusions.
limits: Synthetic increasing IDs and histories; future entity IDs, actual learner history, live inventory changes are not observable. This tests the selection rule, not a future draw.
